module.purpose: Handles seat-specific booking operations by locating an accepted booking, creating or rescheduling a seated attendee, and triggering workflow reminders and webhooks.
module.summary: This module coordinates the booking-seat flow. It queries Prisma for the relevant accepted booking, prevents duplicate attendee enrollment, dispatches either seat creation or seated-booking rescheduling, then schedules reminders and emits webhook payloads when a booking result exists. Dry runs exit before database access, while reminder failures are logged without preventing webhook delivery.
module.businessContext: Supports multi-attendee event bookings where invitees occupy individual seats. Failures can prevent seat assignment, reminders, or downstream booking integrations from being updated.
functions: handleSeats (~L16-161): Locates seated bookings, mutates seat assignments, and triggers downstream notifications

io: Queries Prisma for the accepted booking matching a reschedule or event-time criterion.
Logs reminder scheduling errors through the booking event logger.
network: Schedules workflow reminders for the resulting seated booking.
Triggers downstream booking webhooks for the resulting seated booking.

sectionMap.name: dry-run guard
sectionMap.intent: Stops processing before logger creation or database access during dry runs.

sectionMap.name: accepted booking lookup
sectionMap.intent: Loads the accepted booking and related attendee, user, and seat data.

sectionMap.name: missing rescheduled booking
sectionMap.intent: Rejects rescheduling when no matching accepted booking exists.

sectionMap.name: missing booking exit
sectionMap.intent: Treats an absent booking without reschedule context as a no-op.

sectionMap.name: duplicate attendee guard
sectionMap.intent: Rejects an attendee already assigned to the same booking timeslot.

sectionMap.name: seat mutation dispatch
sectionMap.intent: Selects rescheduling or new-seat creation based on reschedule context.

sectionMap.name: reminder orchestration
sectionMap.intent: Schedules reminders and logs scheduling failures without aborting webhook processing.

sectionMap.name: webhook emission
sectionMap.intent: Builds an accepted-booking payload and sends it to webhook subscribers.

units.name: handleSeats

detail.name: handleSeats
preconditions: newSeatedBookingObject provides an eventType with an id and slug, an evt with startTime, and an invitee array whose first element has an email.
For rescheduling, rescheduleUid identifies an accepted booking.
The referenced event and booking data are available through the configured persistence and booking dependencies.
postconditions: If isDryRun is true, the function returns without querying or mutating booking state.
If no accepted booking matches and rescheduleUid is absent, the function returns without creating a result.
If a seat booking operation produces a result, workflow reminders are attempted and a webhook is triggered.
On successful completion after a seat operation, the result booking is returned.
invariants: Only bookings with status ACCEPTED are selected for processing.
An attendee already registered for the same UTC-formatted start time cannot be registered again.
Workflow-reminder failures do not prevent webhook triggering or result return.
Webhook data reports status as ACCEPTED.
edgeCases: isDryRun true: returns immediately without database lookup, booking operation, reminder scheduling, or webhook triggering.
No matching accepted booking and no rescheduleUid: returns without a booking result.
No matching accepted booking with rescheduleUid: throws an HttpError with status code 404 and the booking-not-found error code.
The first invitee is already an attendee and the stored booking start time formatted in UTC equals evt.startTime: throws an HttpError with status code 409 and the already-signed-up error code.
A workflow reminder dependency rejects: the error is logged and webhook processing continues.
A matching booking with rescheduleUid uses the reschedule path; otherwise it uses the new-seat path.

raises: HttpError with statusCode 404 when rescheduleUid is provided but no accepted booking is found
HttpError with statusCode 409 when the first invitee is already signed up for the same timeslot
Errors from booking lookup, seat creation/rescheduling, or webhook triggering propagate unless handled by their dependencies
errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Duplicate signup is rejected with HttpError status 409; a missing booking during rescheduling is rejected with HttpError status 404.
errorPolicy.returnsOnError: Workflow reminder errors are logged and do not alter the returned booking result; dry runs and non-reschedule missing bookings return undefined.

stateMutations: May create or reschedule booking-seat state through createNewSeat or rescheduleSeatedBooking.
May cause workflow reminder scheduling and webhook side effects.
eventsEmitted: Webhook trigger via handleWebhookTrigger when a result booking is produced.
Workflow reminders via scheduleWorkflowReminders when a result booking is produced.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Queries the accepted booking matching uid rescheduleUid || reqBookingUid or matching eventTypeId and exact startTime. When a result exists, reminder scheduling receives a calendarEvent formed from evt plus rescheduleReason, merged metadata, and event type details; webhook payload combines evt and eventTypeInfo with booking, seat, reschedule, metadata, status, and SMS fields.
detail.summary: Handles seat assignment for an accepted booking, either by rescheduling an existing seated booking or creating a new seat booking. When a booking result is produced, it schedules workflow reminders and triggers the corresponding webhook.

specLiterals.role: Only accepted bookings are eligible for seat handling, and emitted webhook data reports this status.

It rejects with an HttpError whose statusCode is 404 and whose message is ErrorCode.BookingNotFound.
It rejects with an HttpError whose statusCode is 409 and whose message is ErrorCode.AlreadySignedUpForBooking.
